steps.content: It's 7:30 a.m., and the pool just opened. No swimmers are here yet, even the lifeguard chair is unoccupied.
The faint echoes of furious quacks create ripples across the water's surface. A restless figure hops back and forth along the deck.

steps.speaker: Mystery Duck
steps.content:
Quack... Quack quack. Quack quack. Quack! Quack quack quack quack?!
(I can't find my phone, so I'll use this one for now. What's up... What? Another failure?!!)

steps.speaker: Mystery Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack! Quack! Quack?! Quack quack quack! Quack quack quack!
(I told you to follow the specs, but you never listen! You couldn't even get the requests straight! You know how much trouble you caused everyone? Curse you!)

steps.speaker: Mystery Duck
steps.content:
...Quack... Quack quack. Quack quack quack... Quack quack quack?
(...Forget it... It's done, so deal with it yourself. I have real work to do... What about the mole?)

steps.speaker: Mystery Duck
steps.content:
...Quack? Quack?! Quack?!! Quack????!!!!
(Still? Not? Caught? Yet?!!)

steps.speaker: Mystery Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack!!
(Meeting! Are you at work? Meeting, now! Round up all the missing guys for the meeting!)
While jumping around fervently, the duck suddenly slips and falls into the water. Its legs cramp up, and the more it struggles towards the deck, the more the waves push it away.
At this moment, you know she has come to meet you.
...So, here you are.
Ignoring the struggling duck on the other end, 000 dives into the water and retrieves a phone from the bottom of the pool. The phone looks very advanced and is impressively waterproof.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought you'd stop playing this game once you got all the permissions. What a shame. I was just getting into it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm glad you came.
000 tilts her head and looks at you.
You really want to keep playing?
You look at her and remember Moore's instructions.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: From now on, I'll be fully dedicated to the tasks you've given me, and won't be able to support you on the field. My colleagues at the Cybersecurity Center will take over this part of my work. Don't worry, they're all very reliable.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Plus, I need time... a lot of time. Someone needs to draw her full attention.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I'll leave these matters to you, Chief. I'm counting on you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Of course. You don't seem to be in a hurry. Hang out with me a bit?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After all, though this duck isn't directly involved in the development, it can hire new developers at any time and reallocate your hard-earned permissions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, it's just me here. No one else.
So saying, you ring the emergency alarm. The drowning duck is sinking, and the alarm is ringing nearby. Someone will probably arrive soon.
000 just watches you doing this. Then, she finally smiles and responds to your anxious anticipation.
Okay. I'll stay with you.
The colorful field spreads open again. Until the rescuers arrive or until the duck dies, it's your game time.
And you shall glimpse the truth about her... and the power she holds.
